positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Avatar SDK(2020-2021)
• Joined the new Avatar SDK 2 team, mostly as an optimizer. Graphics and CPU.

VrShell Input(2019-2020)
•  Tech lead on new VrShell Input team.
• Mostly working on the new hand interaction model for VrShell
• Also supporting controllers
• Mentoring team members

Avatar SDK(2018-2019)
• On this team briefly. Ported SDK 1 to 64 bit, created new native samples.

Venues 1(2017-2018)
• Another attempt at a large scale social experience. Supported 150 users in a single experience.
• Based on Stadium tech I previously worked on. 
• I spent almost all of my time on this project on Avatar rendering. I was able to optimize the Avatar rendering to support 512 visible avatars on an GearVR/Galaxy S6 headset.

VrShell (2016-2017)
• The new System Software for GearVR and Go(still used on Quest today).
• Another project that I touched almost every system. Graphics, sound, optimization, systems.

Stadium(2016)
•  A never released project experimenting with large scale social experiences. Started by me and one other Engineer as an experiment.
• I mostly worked on the client side, primarily performance optimization to achieve the goal of 1024 users in a single experience.
• Also did some optimization on the backend server tech.

Social Beta(2015-2016)
• Small project, Oculus's first social experience for GearVR. 
• I worked on everything for these projects, graphics, sound, platform, even pushing builds to the store.
• I mostly worked on Social Trivia, and another unreleased game for the system.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on initial bring up of the Lumberyard engine
• Wrote the Lua Editor used in the Lumberyard engine in C++ and QT
• Wrote a graphics unit test framework, using Lumberyards(CryEngine) flow graph system.
• Started the port of Lumberyard(CryEngine) to IOS, my work mostly on the rendering side.

positions.title: Co-Owner / Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed the engine used to create the iOS games "Blade of Betrayal", "Bumble Tales", and "Headstone Harry". Engine is written in c++, using OpenGL ES for graphics and OpenAL for audio.
• Ported Blade of Betrayal to the Android, BlackBerry Playbook, and Samsung Bada platforms.
• Ported Bumble Tales to the BlackBerry Playbook platform.

positions.title: Senior Systems/Technology Engineer
positions.description:
●Worked on porting the game Lococycle to the Xbox One platform
●Performance optimizations for the Xbox One platform. Cut load times in half, 50% performance increase to the draw thread.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on various video codecs, primarily compression and decompression on a tiled DCT based video codec.
• Performance optimizations mostly centered around IO and parallel processing (CPU)
• Designed and developed a C++ REST web services framework

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Section 8 Prejudice
• Primarily responsible for the PS3 sku of the game.
• Managed to reduce memory usage by 80MB without cutting content
• Worked on 3D vision support for the PC sku.
• Worked on the audio engine. Including developing a positional stereo system. Worked on PS3, Xbox and PC audio systems.

Tron Evolution:
• Worked on the stereoscopic 3D mode for Tron on the PS3.
• Set up the stereoscopic video mode, and render targets.
• Modified scaleform 3.2 to give some stereoscopic depth control over the UI.
• Fixed stereoscopic render bugs.

Section 8 PS3:
• Performed the initial work to bring up Section 8 on the PS3 including getting the game to compile and start up.
• Worked on the voice chat system.
• Performed various memory optimizations to fit Section 8 within the PS3 limited system memory.

Section 8:
• First person shooter based on the Unreal Engine.
• Worked on various gameplay systems including dropping, jet pack, mini-map.
• Worked on server simulation and networking layer to improve the games network latency tolerance.
• Optimized memory usage to fit within the Xbox 360's limits.
• Some work on the animation system. Including some performance optimizations, and new animation node types.

Unannounced Lithtech based game: 
• Developed an plug-in for 3D Studio Max to export models, and physics shapes to lithtech's format.
• Worked on the 3rd person camera system.
• Developed various pixel shaders including hair, water, and some post processing effects.

Fear: Perseus Mandate
• Second expansion pack to the original Fear.
• Developed a system to automatically monitor the performance of the game, and report statistics, events, and take screenshots whenever performance problems were encountered.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a code first database ORM system.
• Developed light lz77 compression for the networking layer.
• Various performance optimizations.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description: Developed web applications in Java(tomcat) using Hibernate, spring, tapestry, and ajax(before tapestry had built in support).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed software for the PocketPC platform using C++.
• Optimized the performance of C and C++ code.
• Developed database backed web applications using java servlet technology. Used Hibernate, spring, and tapestry frameworks.

positions.title: Mobile Games Developer
positions.description:
• Co-Owner of a small indie game development studio, which developed mobile games for the PocketPC platform.
• Designed and developed the core engine used for Blade of Betrayal using c++ and arm assembly.
• Was awarded Action Game of the Year from Pocket PC Magazine in 2003 (Blade of Betrayal)

positions.title: Electronic Technician
positions.description:
•Programming Crestron touch screen control systems.
•Design electronic classrooms
•Install electronic media systems into "smart" classrooms.

positions.title: Electronic Technician
positions.description:
273rd Engineering and Installation Squadron
Installation of various electronic systems

positions.title: Radar Technician
positions.description: Repair and service the electronic systems of the AN/TPS75 Aerospace control and warning radar system.
